title: Past the Third Marker
who: pilot of the lead hauler in a four-hauler string
want: Keep a four-hauler string moving past the third marker with its cargo of air seals for a hab that has paid in advance.
at_stake: The string turns back, the hab's order lapses and your crew is left holding the seals.
complication: The waiting convoy asks whether to turn back; fear climbs on a visible clock. (complications.md, trade run 3)

approaches.label: Read the hab's paid order aloud
Check the string's challenge words
approaches.npc_reaction: does not trust an open channel

Fly at the string's tail.clean: the hab pays your crew a bonus because the string arrives intact
Fly at the string's tail.cost: a hauler clips a mooring line and your crew pays for the repair
Fly at the string's tail.fail: the string scatters and the hab traffic desk files the delay against your crew

Read the hab's paid order aloud.clean: the pilots in the string talk about your crew at every hab after this
Read the hab's paid order aloud.cost: the hab pays your crew its fee but the traffic desk logs the late arrival against you
Read the hab's paid order aloud.fail: your crew pays the string's fuel to turn back to the third marker

Check the string's challenge words.clean: the string calms and the traffic desk notes your crew kept it together
Check the string's challenge words.cost: your crew pays a hauler to re-key its challenge words
Check the string's challenge words.fail: the pilots blame your crew for the delay and the traffic desk hears it

sensory_details_used.sound: overlapping old voices looping from wreck beacons
sensory_details_used.light: amber beacons each on their own rhythm
